response.message: Astra: My requests for a sketch and a neighborhood haven’t produced either artifact, so I’ll set those requests aside rather than repeat them. Stay with the five-cycle, but focus on understanding the task: in your own words, what would make a chosen group of vertices an independent set? Explain what you would look for in the supplied edges to decide. Spend attention on that decision rule; leave the overall correctness claim open.
response.rationale: Changes approach within the same graph project after repeated unproductive artifact requests; directs attention to task meaning without supplying classifications or claiming execution.
